criteria.criterion: Compatible explicit enclosing job (kill-on-close, no breakaway, no UI limits, verified nestable from inside): nested helper succeeds; helper tree is a member of the enclosing job

Helper owns a private kill-on-close job assigned at creation: every helper root is already in a job at its first witnessed instruction (handshake); detached, PowerShell-created and nested descendants are collected with it
criteria.note: Helper roots inAnyJob at handshake: candidate 23/23 (matched), 23/23 (job-host), 12/12 (ext); baseline 0/26. Atomicity of PROC_THREAD_ATTRIBUTE_JOB_LIST assignment itself is an API property (see C27).

criteria.note: Launcher elapsed 15,128-15,157 ms; first job termination 15,106-15,124 ms after launcher start. Four sequential 5 s probes refuse inside 15-18 s in the maintained control (see C24).

criteria.note: Every launcher-collected termination carries 3762750553: matched 9/9, job-host 9/9, ext 6/6. Launcher exit 11-50 ms after the first termination. The code assertion is not applied to creator death (C10).

criteria.criterion: Both EOFs and zero active processes required for success; ordinary short-lived members (pipe-holding and no-pipe) quiesce inside the window
Caller stdio is never held by the helper tree (explicit handle list: NUL stdin and two private pipe writers only)
criteria.note: Caller EOF after launcher exit: max 0 ms (matched, job-host, 21 invocations each), max 4 ms (ext); baseline had 4 invocations pending until teardown. Handle-level enumeration of the helper tree was not collected.

criteria.criterion: Creator death at acknowledged points (helper-ready; root-exited with descendants ready): exact launcher handle terminated, harness job held open, helper tree ends within 2 s by the private job, before any harness teardown
criteria.note: All 7 helper-tree processes ended 4-6 ms after the launcher was killed with OS-assigned kill-on-close exit code 0 (no 0xE0470459 assertion: the launcher never called TerminateJobObject). Baseline: all survived.

criteria.criterion: Job accounting with observer handles retained and after they close (open harness job; the private job's own accounting is launcher self-observation)
criteria.note: Active processes 0 with witness handles retained and again after closing them, totals unchanged. Success with retained observer handles also holds in every base-suite success case.

criteria.criterion: Incompatible enclosing job (in-job probe: nested and plain creation refused with 1816): refusal before the first helper exists, actionable helper-containment diagnostic, unrelated sentinel and job sibling survive
criteria.note: Exactly one process (the launcher) added to the enclosing job across the click; refusal in 138 ms (formal run). Baseline refused with helper-unavailable.

criteria.criterion: Warm click on an incompatible host refuses even with a live matching gateway; the existing gateway stays directly callable
Outer job with a verified effective UI restriction that prevents nesting
criteria.limit: Not constructible on this host: every UI restriction (each of the 8 flags and 0xFF) reads back effective from inside the job, yet nested CreateProcess(JOB_LIST) and AssignProcessToJobObject succeed on Windows 11 10.0.26300. Nesting failed only when the inner job also had UI restrictions (error 50), which the candidate's private job never has. The launcher inside an all-UI-restricted job behaved as the verified capability predicts (nested helper ran, sibling survived). The verified incompatible host for C12/C13 is an active-process-limited job instead.

criteria.criterion: Concurrent drain: unread-stderr deadlock removed (1 MiB stderr flood then valid result succeeds); stderr is discarded and never forwarded
Stdout retention capped at 256 KiB: exactly 262,144 bytes accepted; 262,145 refused helper-invalid; oversize from a running root refused inside the work window with job termination
Strict UTF-8 and complete stage-protocol validation inside the work window (helper-invalid)
criteria.note: An invalid byte inside an otherwise valid held ownership answer refuses helper-invalid on the candidate; the lenient baseline reported store-held.

Evidence limited to source inspection (Launcher.cs HelperProcess.Read finally block and Pipe.TransferCompletion) and the maintained control's cleanup-confirmed path.

criteria.limit: Not natively inducible on this Windows 11 host without fault injection into the product. Evidence: source inspection and positive maintained CheckCapability on a compatible host. The incompatible enclosing job exercises only the CreateProcess-refusal branch.

criteria.criterion: Staged installation validates attribute capability before replacing configuration or shortcuts
criteria.limit: Not exercised. --validate-install requires a full Chrome PWA configuration. By design CheckCapability only creates the job and attribute list, so it cannot detect a host that later refuses creation; click-time refusal is covered by C12/C13.
